1946, March 2nd
Che following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.N. Cap.
Narch 2nd 1945 St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, IT.Y. Mr. J .J. O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois My Dear Friends Joseph - Joseph and Winifred:
God bless you and keep you well. - you and yours. I'd like to write you a real letter but this is just to thank you for crate of fine oranges received here in excellent condition a few days back. They are very good. - in fact I think the best yet. How wonderful is the dear Lord in all His works!
Praised Be The Lord!
Dr. Solanus O.F .M. Cap
1946, March 15th
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servert of God, Father Solanus Casey, C.F.M. Cap.
March 15th 1946. St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y.
Mir. Joseph ODonnell. 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois.
God bless you Josph O'Donnell - you and yours.
I was in hopes to catch up with my correspondence and then write you, but it seems the letters come faster and faster so that I have to keep right on the job; and the longer I wait the core what's not too urgent gets snowed under.
At all events I want to say at least thank you for the big crate of fine Grape-fruit. Nony thanks indeed. ^You can see for yourself. this is hardly an expert an underwood.
God bless and keep us all. Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
